recipe.criteria: Upright bench seated position, feet planted and knees 90 degrees. Rope pulled toward sides of face with elbows outward and stable trunk. Cable pulley at head height, equal fixed-length rope branches and lifting weight stack. 3.5 seconds pull, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds return.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
